instructions: Prepare the vegetables, aromatics, lentils, and legumes for lentil and spinach soup.
Heat the cooking vessel and soften the aromatics until fragrant.
Add the seasoned lentils and cook it until browned or heated through as appropriate.
Stir in the legumes, vegetables, and sauce and cook until the mixture is tender and cohesive.
Taste the lentil and spinach soup, adjust the seasoning, and portion it evenly while warm.
